description: Recent news and hiring movement for companies the user already knows, several at once, split into what is new since the last check and what was already reported. Use for watching companies over time: what has happened at my clients, is anyone hiring, anything I should know before I reach out. When running on a schedule, report only the new items and stay silent when there are none. For one company in depth use research_company; for the open web use web_search.

only_new.description: Return only items published since this user last checked that company. Default false. Set true on a scheduled run.

name: company_signals
title: Company news and hiring
